description: This file defines the AWCProxyContainer class, which is a specialized container class for process management within the WPEFramework's ProcessContainers namespace. It includes a nested DBusInterface class for DBus communication, manages process state, and provides methods for starting, stopping, and querying process status.

classes.name: AWCProxyContainer
classes.description: A container class that manages process lifecycle and state communication via DBus, extending AWCContainerBase.

classes.name: AWCProxyContainer::DBusInterface
classes.description: A nested class handling DBus communication and state change notifications for the AWCProxyContainer.

methods.name: waitForStateChange
methods.description: Waits for a change in the process state within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the process managed by the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the process within the container.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the process within the container, with a specified timeout.
